newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates lightly quoted, weak tone.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates lightly quoted, weak tone.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were lightly quoted at the St. Louis Merchants Exchange Friday, and some values were lower.
No barges traded versus none on Friday.
- One barge, Mississippi (St Louis), this week, no bid, offered 110 percent of tariff - no comparison.
- Two barges, Mississippi (Osceola through Cairo), next week, bid 90 percent - down 7-1/2 percentage points, no offer.
- Four barges, Illinois, two each week of February 16 and 23, no bid, offered 160 percent - down 2-1/2 points.
- Eight barges, two each week of March, Mississippi (Osceola through Cairo), no bid, offered 110 percent - no comparison.
- Five barges, mid-Mississippi, 30-day open, no bid, offered 165 percent, unchanged.
